description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Woodfall Primus enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Woodfall Primus trigger, destroying a noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7.
Repeat.
